_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 58 windows producing a ±2-point move, the coil is statistically dominant and the honest call is HOLD with conviction until a liquidity or flow breaker materializes.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction toward Disbelief; narrative implies accumulation-to-Hope upside. The split is resolved by leaning to the analyst's higher-trust, base-rate-anchored read.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with exchange netflow reversing below 50 and CVD turning negative — signals distribution ending and accumulation resuming, allowing a Hope test
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 102 and BTC funding turning deeply negative — forces a Panic/Anxiety slide, invalidating coil stability
